Fine-grained Personal Access Token mit L: Fine-grained personal access token with read access to the repository's issues.
GitHub ist nicht konfiguriert (Repositor: GitHub is not configured (repository or API token missing).
GitHub lehnt den API-Token ab (:status): GitHub rejects the API token (:status) — please check the fine-grained PAT.
GitHub-API antwortet mit Fehlerstatus :s: GitHub API responds with error status :status.
Importiert GitHub-Issues eines Repositor: Imports GitHub issues of a repository as tasks (idempotent per issue, pull requests are filtered): time tracking and billing in WorkDiary, GitHub stays in the lead. Polling with a since checkpoint, webhook trigger optional.
Nur die Issues dieses Repositories werde: Only the issues of this repository are imported.
Optional: Shared-Secret des GitHub-Webho: Optional: shared secret of the GitHub webhook (issues events, X-Hub-Signature-256). Without a secret the webhook endpoint stays disabled; polling catches up on everything.
Schließt das verknüpfte Issue (mit Notiz: Closes the linked issue (with a note) when the task is completed in workDiary and reopens it when the task is reopened. Title and description remain owned by the source system. The token needs write access to issues.
